about: Modwerk source-only quick-velocity-aftertouch-assign package for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74, compiled from sdk/analog-rytm-mkii/modules/quick-velocity-aftertouch-assign.

mods.title: Improved Modulation
mods.summary: Hold FIX, SAMPLER or LFO and turn a knob to link it to velocity, aftertouch or the LFO; hold SCENE or QPER and turn to lock it in a scene or performance; record performance moves.
mods.description: Hold FIX and turn a knob on a sound page to link that parameter to velocity, SAMPLER for aftertouch, or LFO to make it the LFO's destination; further turns set the amount or the LFO's depth. It fills the sound's own four velocity and four aftertouch mod slots and its LFO destination and depth, and while the key is held each linked knob shows its amount as a performance lock does. Holding SCENE shows the scene's locks and a turn locks that parameter in the active scene (or the last engaged one, or the one scene edit shows) without opening scene edit; pads during the hold pick tracks, REC, STOP and PLAY copy, paste and clear the scene, and a hold let go with nothing touched opens scene edit on the release. Since 0.5.0 it also holds QPER Live Rec: hold QPER and turn a knob to set the linked performance's locks, QPER + YES writes them into the kit (a second YES undoes), QPER + PLAY, RECORD and STOP clear, copy and paste, and in LIVE RECORDING performance moves are kept and written into the pattern with RECORD + YES.
mods.author: npp1993
mods.on_unit: On an Analog Rytm MKII on OS 1.74, as reported by the author: Improved Mod Assign 0.1 to 0.4.0 and QPER Live Rec 0.1.0 to 0.3.0 as recorded in TESTING.md. 0.5.0's source passed the test rig's scene and QPER cases (QS11, QS13) and the author's hand test (QS12) on private development images; its final review fixes and this package's own image ran in rytm-emu only.
